title: Fixed Curved Head Vaulting Table
description: One newly authored complete fixed vaulting-table exterior. A wide short crowned head has a progressively rising forward nose, changing side width and full thick curved lower shell, carried on a broad underhead saddle and one rear-offset tapered column. A whole connected fork-ended ground chassis has genuine front/rear recesses and a wide central column mount. All numeric head/base/column meshes are newly authored. It is not the existing long narrow horizontal two-pommel horse with its handles removed or a shortened balance beam: the complete broad head geometry and single offset support/base layout are different. Three opaque untextured solid PBR roles, metres, Z up, full horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. One complete prop, zero scenes, no athlete, springboard or extra equipment counts. Static illustrative exterior only: no official apparatus dimensions, adjustment, padding response, athlete fit, vault technique, loading, stability, manufacture or safety claim.
